sections.description:

* Preserves original text case (if you add \”WordPress SEO\” it won’t change \”wordpress seo\” to \”WordPress SEO\”)
* Links only once per keyword per page to avoid over-optimization
* Direct database content modification for proper SEO crawling

⚡ Performance Optimized
* Server-friendly background processing with configurable batch sizes
* Smart caching system to reduce server load
* Real-time progress tracking with estimated completion time
* Works efficiently on websites with millions of pages and posts

📊 Comprehensive Analytics

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “AI Internal Linking Tool By KumarHarshit.In”
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate
  5. Go to AI Internal Linking in your admin menu to start

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the downloaded zip file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Go to AI Internal Linking in your admin menu

After Installation

  1. Add Keywords: Go to AI Internal Linking and add your first keyword-URL pairs
  2. Configure Settings: Visit the Settings page to configure post types and link density
  3. Import Bulk Data: Use the Import/Export page for bulk keyword additions
  4. Monitor Progress: Check the Reports page for analytics and processing status
sections.faq:
Does this plugin slow down my website?

No! The plugin is designed to be extremely performance-friendly. All processing happens in the background using WordPress cron jobs, and we use smart caching to minimize server load. The plugin works efficiently even on shared hosting.

How many keywords can I add?

By default, you can add up to 500 keyword pairs. This limit can be adjusted in the settings if needed. The plugin is designed to handle large keyword sets efficiently.

Will it change the formatting of my existing content?

No, the plugin preserves your original text formatting. If you add \”WordPress SEO\” as a keyword, it will only link exact matches and won’t change \”wordpress seo\” to \”WordPress SEO\” – it will link the text as it appears.

Can I control which post types are processed?

Yes! The plugin automatically detects all post types on your site and lets you choose which ones to process. You can enable/disable linking for posts, pages, custom post types, etc.

What happens to existing links in my content?

The plugin intelligently detects existing links and won’t add internal links where links already exist. It also won’t interfere with your manually created links.

Can I import keywords in bulk?

Yes! You can import keywords via CSV or Excel files. The plugin provides sample templates and comprehensive import guides to make bulk operations easy.

How do I prevent over-optimization?

The plugin includes smart link density controls. You can set the maximum number of internal links per 100 words (default is 1). It also ensures only one link per keyword per page.

Can I exclude certain headings from linking?

Yes! You can choose which heading levels (H1-H6) should be processed for internal linking, or disable heading linking entirely.

What happens when I delete a keyword?

Deleted keywords go to a trash system for 30 days where you can restore them. When permanently deleted, all associated internal links are automatically removed from your content.

Is my data safe if I uninstall the plugin?

The plugin includes a complete uninstall process that removes all data including internal links, database tables, and settings. Your original content is completely restored to its pre-plugin state.

Does it work with page builders?

Yes! The plugin works with any content stored in the WordPress post_content field, including content from page builders like Elementor, Gutenberg, etc.

Can I see which pages have been linked?

Yes! The Reports section shows detailed analytics including which keywords are used where, usage statistics, and performance metrics.

Does it support multilingual sites?

The plugin works with any content in the WordPress database and supports all character sets. It works well with multilingual plugins like WPML and Polylang.

Is there a limit on website size?

No! The plugin is designed to work efficiently on websites of any size – from small blogs to large enterprise sites with millions of pages.

Can I export my keyword data?

Yes! You can export all your keywords to CSV format for backup or to use on other websites.
